Romapada.note: Citraratha, called Romapada, king of Anga. Sonless, he was given his friend Dasharatha's daughter Shanta as his own, and married her to Rishyasringa; by the sage's grace he got a son at last. SB 9.23.7-10

BaliAnu.name: Bali
BaliAnu.note: Emperor of the world in the Anu line, and sonless. Not Bali the Daitya, Prahlada's grandson. SB 9.23.4-5

SudeshnaAnga.name: Sudeshna
SudeshnaAnga.note: Queen of Bali. Six sons by the sage Dirghatamas, each of whom took a kingdom in the east. SB 9.23.5-6

people.Anga: Eldest of the six; the Anga kingdom, whose throne Duryodhana would one day give to Karna, keeps his name. SB 9.23.5-6
people.Vanga: One of the six sons of Dirghatamas by Bali's queen. SB 9.23.5
people.Kalinga: One of the six sons of Dirghatamas by Bali's queen. SB 9.23.5
people.Suhma: One of the six sons of Dirghatamas by Bali's queen. SB 9.23.5
people.Pundra: One of the six sons of Dirghatamas by Bali's queen. SB 9.23.5
people.Odra: One of the six sons of Dirghatamas by Bali's queen. SB 9.23.5
people.Chaturanga: Born to Romapada by the grace of Rishyasringa. SB 9.23.10
people.Prithulaksha: Three sons: Brihadratha, Brihatkarma and Brihadbhanu. SB 9.23.10-11

BrihadrathaAnga.name: Brihadratha
BrihadrathaAnga.note: Eldest son of Prithulaksha. Not Brihadratha of Magadha. SB 9.23.11

JayadrathaAnga.name: Jayadratha
JayadrathaAnga.note: Not Jayadratha of Sindhu, Dushala's husband. SB 9.23.11-12

VijayaAnga.name: Vijaya
VijayaAnga.note: Son of Jayadratha by his wife Sambhuti. SB 9.23.12

Sambhuti.note: Wife of Jayadratha of Anga, mother of Vijaya. SB 9.23.12

unions.note: Niyoga: begotten for the sonless Bali, and counted as his. SB 9.23.5-6
